rca of the issue: Iter149 + Iter150-A CSS overrides in /app/frontend/src/index.css lines 339-378 added bg-{color}-200 overrides + bg-{stone,neutral,zinc}-100 — they correctly handle the strongest-leak utilities. However the tailwind -50 shade (the very lightest) was NOT added, AND tailwind's opacity-modifier syntax (bg-X-50/80) compiles to a DIFFERENT rgba() value than the base class, so even an override on .bg-X-50 wouldn't match .bg-X-50/80. To fix completely, target both class names OR use a CSS attribute selector like [class*='bg-gray-50'] inside html.dark scope. The pricing table td uses bare bg-purple-50 (no opacity modifier) so a simple html.dark td.bg-purple-50{background:transparent;color:var(--text)} fixes it.
